text:
emma_partnerships: Quick thread  Astra Hardware asked if they can co-fund GPU credits in our private offer for the marketplace listing. They want SKU-level visibility. Decision needed this week for marketplace publication.

luke_hw_partners: Astra can commit to 30 GPU credits/month for Tier 1 and 100 credits/month for Tier 2, but they'd like a branding mention and a "hardware credits provided by Astra" line. They'd also like a 5% OEM co-marketing discount off list to make the bundle compelling.

zoe_finance: Important: we need to cost those credits into our unit economics. Who invoices whom? If Astra pays directly to the customer, fine. If Redwood subsidizes, we need a rebate agreement. Also: propose renewal uplift cap of 7% instead of 10% because of sensitive enterprise budgets.

nate_sales: From GTM: customers expect a simple SKU. Suggest two bundle SKUs: RBW-ASTRA-BASE and RBW-ASTRA-PRO with clear commit ranges. Headline customer discount could be 28% for PRO at $300k+ commit. We'll push co-sell commitments for joint pipeline registration.

maya_si: CloudCraft (our SI) wants implementation credits (8%) for any deal where CloudCraft does >30% of delivery hours. They prefer the rebate applied to the final invoice and a registered partner PO in the marketplace flow. Request a short registration workflow: customer selects SI at checkout, SI confirms within 10 business days.

priya_legal: Legal flags: (1) branding attribution ok but need joint brand guidelines and approval flow, (2) any OEM-provided credits must be documented in an MSA addendum to avoid warranty/indemnity exposure, (3) renewal uplift cap 7% is acceptable with carve-outs for tax/regulatory changes and material increases in underlying cloud provider fees. We should include a "hardware credit termination" clause if Astra discontinues the program with 90 days notice.

emma_partnerships: Proposed pricing matrix - feedback please:
```
SKU: RBW-ASTRA-BASE
Commit: $100k - $299k
Discount: 20% off list
Astra GPU credits: 30/mo (customer-facing)
SI rebate: 6% if CloudCraft registered

SKU: RBW-ASTRA-PRO
Commit: $300k+
Discount: 28% off list (headline for press)
Astra GPU credits: 100/mo + 1-month onboarding credit
SI rebate: 8% + extra 2% if Astra-sourced pipeline >50%
```

zoe_finance: Needs clarification: "1-month onboarding credit" value for Dedicated vs Hosted. Also require default cost split rows: Astra covers credit value up to $X/month or Redwood will absorb up to 50% of GPU cost beyond that. Draft line item needed for marketplace invoice mapping.

luke_hw_partners: Astra prefers paying SI credits directly to CloudCraft where possible to simplify ops. They can do a monthly remittance to Redwood which then passes through to SI. Need our finance to accept incoming remittances and reconcile.

priya_legal: I'll draft an addendum template for OEM credits and the marketplace listing blurb. Also will add a clause: "renewal pricing increases above cap require written consent from both parties."

partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace SKU naming standards -> https://redwood.internal/marketplace/sku-guidelines :bookmark_tabs:  and prior Astra pilot thread -> https://redwood.internal/archives/astrapilot :eyes:

emma_partnerships: Action items: zoe to produce cost-split table by Wed COB; priya to push MSA addendum draft; maya to write the SI registration flow (10-business-day confirm); nate to prepare external-facing SKU descriptions for marketplace. Sync Fri 9am PT to finalize for May listing.

nate_sales: Will prepare press-safe language for the 28% headline but will note that executive approval required for any exceptions.

zoe_finance: Acknowledged, starting cost model now.

emma_partnerships: Thanks everyone  let's lock by Friday or we'll miss Astra's marketing calendar. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
